# Fixture manifest.
#
# Format (colon-separated, 3 fields):
#   <base_name>:<binaries>:<description>
#
# base_name  - shared stem of <base_name>.in / <base_name>.out in this directory.
#              Must be <= 8 characters - see tests/README.md ("Filename length
#              constraint") for why.
# binaries   - comma-separated list of binary names (as built by the gfortran
#              commands in README.md/CLAUDE.md) this fixture is valid input for.
#              A fixture must only list binaries whose interactive prompt
#              sequence actually matches what's encoded in <base_name>.in - see
#              tests/README.md before adding an entry.
# description - short human-readable summary of what the fixture exercises.

test1:mssel,msseld:3-trait discrete 1-stage selection, FS/HS groups, common environmental effects (ported from the original SelAction distribution's smoke test)
test2s:mssel,msseld:3-trait discrete 2-stage selection (sel2s), own performance in stage 1 then added BLUP breeding values in stage 2, no FS/HS/progeny groups, same genetic parameters as test1
test3s:mssel,msseld:3-trait discrete 3-stage selection (sel3s), own performance in stage 1, BLUP breeding values added in stage 2, FS+HS group information added in stage 3, same genetic parameters and FS/HS group sizes as test1
blup1:mssel,msseld:3-trait discrete 1-stage selection (sel1s) isolating the BLUP-specific branch of the inbreeding calculation (dFmtblup/hyper_correct in selinbreeding.f90): all 3 traits use only BLUP breeding values (code 2) plus the half-sib group (code 24) as information sources, terminated by -1 - no own performance or full-sib info, unlike test1's mixed source list; same genetic parameters and HS group size as test1
advgrp:mssel,msseld:3-trait discrete 1-stage selection (sel1s) adversarial coverage for the unconfigured-group-type matrix-block guards in selection_index (selroutines.f90): full-sib groups left fully unconfigured (fsgroups=0) while half-sib (1 group, code 24) AND progeny groups (1 group, code 64) are both configured and actually selected as info sources - the progeny-group path (matp's i+63 block) was previously untested by any fixture; also zeroes the ADG-FCR common environmental correlation to exercise a legitimately-zero numerator term inside the group-block formulas
